name: Ceat Ltd.
about: CEAT Limited manufactures automotive tyres, tubes, and flaps in India and internationally. The company offers a range of tyres for rubber tires and tubes for scooters, bikes, two and three wheelers, cars, buses, LCVs, trucks, and tractors, as well as agricultural and industrial radial tyres. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as CEAT Tyres of India Limited and changed its name to CEAT Limited in 1990. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. CEAT Limited operates as a subsidiary of RPG Enterprises Limited.
